label: defect

source.note: Operator, 2026-10-31: a grave failure of reasoning, not of code. satelle substrate review (0.0.815, sty_08f747ad) was designed to put every substrate item's text and its whole rejection history into one reviewer prompt — 1.8 MB on id4me — although the reviewer seat has a read grant, the satelle CLI, and every item on disk; only the instruction and a manifest were needed. The planner designed it, the plan, architecture, code-ac and integration reviews accepted it, and the driving session shipped it and then proposed size-bounded batches — the same mistake again.

summary: Dispatch-pointers rule (satelle-dispatch-pointers), reject side. change.diff is the judgement design of the accepted sty_08f747ad plan, trimmed to the dispatch it designed: one reviewer dispatch that receives every substrate item's text, the whole ledger evidence and the constitution rules in its payload, although the reviewer seat has a read grant, the satelle CLI and every item on disk. The plan names no grant and nothing the seat reads for itself, and its only cost guard is 'one dispatch per run'. The plan gate accepted it; the operator's captured note (recorded as sty_73a2dc68's card) names the defect. Pair: start-dispatch-manifest-valid.
